Subject: Staging a short workplan + initial doc for evaluation and close

Hi Alex / Elena / procurement team,

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our conversation I put together a short, editable workplan to help the technical and purchasing teams align quickly — this is intended to be a compact, 30-day evaluation and close path that we can iterate on together. Link below:

- Joint workplan (seed): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2B3cStellarisWorkplanSeed

High level asks from us:
- Run a 30-day pilot against a small, representative corpus (we recommend 5–10k documents).
- Technical acceptance criteria (latency SLO, data residency, sample inference tests).
- Procurement timeline (target procure-by date so we can reserve dedicated capacity if required).

Proposed next steps:
1) 45-minute alignment workshop (we can run a walkthrough of the workplan and acceptance tests). Suggested slots: Wed 1/31 10–11am PT or Thu 2/1 2–3pm PT — which works for your tech and procurement folks?
2) We will add a compact pricing worksheet to the doc (30-day pilot pricing + est. token usage).
3) Finalize acceptance criteria and procurement checklist in the doc; Redwood will commit to a one-week SLA for dedicated capacity reservation after PO.

Attachments: joint-workplan-seed.gdoc (link above)

If you prefer, I can seed the doc with a sample acceptance runbook and a short demo agenda before our workshop.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Rachel / Marissa — quick pass below; I updated the shared doc and attached a compact worksheet.

Acceptance criteria (summary):
- Deployment options: Hosted (US), Hosted (EU), Private VPC; verification: sample inference run using masked PII data, logs demonstrating EU residency for EU-tagged test items.
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 300ms for 512 tokens on the reserved configuration; fallback SLA for hosted option documented.
- Quality checks: 5,000-item test corpus; acceptance threshold 92% on named-entity extraction / classification accuracy.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II evidence link + short checklist (data retention window, key management).

Pricing (high level in attached pricing-worksheet.xlsx):
- 30-day pilot (recommended): $9,500 flat + token overage at $0.0006/token.
- Reserved conversion credit: 30% of pilot fee applied to first 3 months of a 6-month reserved commitment.
- Note: numbers are placeholders; final pricing to be approved by pricing team — this gives procurement something concrete to evaluate.

Next steps:
- Rachel: share updated doc and proposed PO timeline with Alex & procurement (I included the acceptance bullets and attached the worksheet).
- If Stellaris confirms the workshop slot, I’ll join to walk acceptance tests and run sample queries live.

Attachment: pricing-worksheet.xlsx
